<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>12</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
    <RootNamespace>Aspose.Pdf</RootNamespace>

    <!-- Package / release metadata -->
    <PackageId>Aspose.PDF.FOSS</PackageId>
    <Version>26.9.0</Version>
    <Product>Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET</Product>
    <PackageReleaseNotes>
v26.9.0 - rendering and cross-platform release.

New: PdfFileSanitization repairs files too damaged to load (header/EOF waste, broken cross-reference table); DateField form fields; HideAction; ruby and warichu tagged-structure elements with the StructureTypeStandard role set; a composite drawing Path shape; typed exceptions for empty values, forbidden font embedding, signature-length mismatch and missing optional dependencies (the printing guard names the package to add).
Rendering: dash patterns on software strokes, soft masks (matte, backdrop, isolated/non-isolated groups), colour-key masks, overprint and multi-spot ink spaces, tiling-pattern ranges, function-based shadings, indexed images with soft masks, DPI-exact output, annotations rotating with the page, sub-pixel-thin images.
Text: horizontal scaling and negative sizes flip and stretch glyphs, vertical CMaps, substitute faces for fonts without a program, CJK radical fallback, whole-paragraph re-flow on replace.
Cross-platform: managed BMP/JPEG/TIFF paths, font fallback by name, case-blind and Windows-authored asset paths, glyph recognition, redaction and image colour sampling all work off Windows.
Also: PDF 2.0 saves move descriptive Info text into XMP and write non-Latin-1 text as UTF-16BE; PDF/A conversion refuses live-signed files and exempts freshly UA-converted documents from the untagged-content scan; signature trust reads intermediates from the per-user store; action Next chains and submit targets; XMP structs stay live; forms treat a field as the collection of its widgets; plus HTML-to-PDF, generator table, facade and annotation fixes.

Full release notes: https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET/releases/tag/v26.9.0
    </PackageReleaseNotes>
    <Authors>Aspose</Authors>
    <Company>Aspose Pty Ltd</Company>
    <Copyright>Copyright (c) 2026 Aspose Pty Ltd</Copyright>
    <Description>A free, open-source PDF library for .NET 8+: read, create, modify, and render PDF documents. Provides an Aspose.PDF-compatible API surface for common PDF scenarios. Some features are incomplete and the public API may change between releases.</Description>
    <PackageLicenseExpression>MIT</PackageLicenseExpression>
    <PackageProjectUrl>https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET</PackageProjectUrl>
    <RepositoryUrl>https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET.git</RepositoryUrl>
    <RepositoryType>git</RepositoryType>
    <PackageTags>pdf;aspose;pdf-library;acroform;pdf-a;document;foss</PackageTags>
    <PackageReadmeFile>README.md</PackageReadmeFile>
    <PackageIcon>icon.png</PackageIcon>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Packed into the NuGet package when/if `dotnet pack` is run; inert for plain builds. -->
    <None Include="..\README.md" Pack="true" PackagePath="\" />
    <None Include="icon.png" Pack="true" PackagePath="\" />
  </ItemGroup>

<ItemGroup>
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Aspose.Pdf.Foss.Tests" Condition="'$(ExcludeInternalsVisibleTo)' != 'true'" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Without InternalsVisibleTo the compiler warns (CS0649) on internal fields a friend
       assembly could assign; suppress it in the pack build so the DLL stays identical. -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(ExcludeInternalsVisibleTo)' == 'true'">
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);CS0649</NoWarn>
  </PropertyGroup>

<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="System.Drawing.Common" Version="8.0.0" />
</ItemGroup>

<!-- SonarSource's C# rules - the same engine a SonarQube server applies, delivered as
     analyzers that run inside the compiler. OFF unless asked for: a first analysis of a
     library this size reports thousands of findings, and TreatWarningsAsErrors above
     would turn every one of them into a build error. Every ordinary build - the test
     jobs, pack, sign, the compat harness - therefore sees the project exactly as before.

     To read the findings:
       dotnet build src/Aspose.Pdf.Foss.csproj -c Release -p:RunSonarAnalyzer=true \
         -p:TreatWarningsAsErrors=false "-p:ErrorLog=issues.sarif%2Cversion=2.1"
     or run the sonar-issues job, which renders that SARIF into a report by rule.

     The findings are advisory. Promoting a chosen subset to real warnings belongs in
     .editorconfig, deliberately, once the backlog has been read. -->
<ItemGroup Condition="'$(RunSonarAnalyzer)' == 'true'">
  <PackageReference Include="SonarAnalyzer.CSharp" Version="10.33.0.1635" PrivateAssets="all" />
</ItemGroup>

<ItemGroup>
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Devices\CmykToRgbLut.bin" />
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Text\Resources\DjVuDingbats.ttf" LogicalName="Aspose.Pdf.Text.Resources.DjVuDingbats.ttf" />
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Text\Resources\AdobeCid.Japan1.bin" LogicalName="Aspose.Pdf.Text.Resources.AdobeCid.Japan1.bin" />
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Text\Resources\AdobeCid.CNS1.bin" LogicalName="Aspose.Pdf.Text.Resources.AdobeCid.CNS1.bin" />
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Text\Resources\AdobeCid.GB1.bin" LogicalName="Aspose.Pdf.Text.Resources.AdobeCid.GB1.bin" />
  <EmbeddedResource Include="Text\Resources\AdobeCid.Korea1.bin" LogicalName="Aspose.Pdf.Text.Resources.AdobeCid.Korea1.bin" />
</ItemGroup>

  <!-- Force a full rebuild of this project on EVERY build, even when no source
       has changed. Two layers can otherwise skip the build:
         1) DisableFastUpToDateCheck stops Visual Studio short-circuiting via its
            fast up-to-date check, so VS always invokes MSBuild on this project.
         2) Deleting the intermediate assembly before CoreCompile defeats
            MSBuild's own incremental compile, forcing the C# compiler to run.
       Trade-off: every build recompiles this project, so builds/test runs are
       slower. Remove this block to return to normal incremental builds. -->
  <PropertyGroup>
    <DisableFastUpToDateCheck>true</DisableFastUpToDateCheck>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <Target Name="ForceAlwaysRecompile" BeforeTargets="CoreCompile">
    <Delete Files="@(IntermediateAssembly)" />
  </Target>

</Project>
